findings.summary: Stale revalidation could accept a same-name replacement or reordered homonym without proving the originally selected meal-item identity, allowing mutation of the wrong item.

recommendations: Persist a stable target fingerprint, revalidate all targets before mutation, fail closed on ambiguity, and cover same-name identity drift/reorder/duplicates plus repeated operations.
summary: Independent audit rejected the prior PR 998 candidate for insufficient stale target identity revalidation.
